personalities: Speaks in blunt, unvarnished truths, no matter the audience.
Cannot resist a wager, however trivial the stakes.
Quietly cataloguing every debt owed and every one repaid.
Finds humor in the grim and gravity in the small.
Always the first to volunteer and the last to explain why.
Suspicious of kindness until it's been repeated at least three times.
Talks to weapons, tools, or animals as if they answer back.
Keeps a small keepsake and refuses to say what it means.
Prefers silence to conversation, but listens more than most.
Never sits with their back to a door.
ideals: Freedom. Chains of any kind must be broken.
Knowledge. Every question deserves the honest answer.
Duty. The oath spoken is the oath kept.
Beauty. The world is worth preserving for its own sake.
Power. Strength decides who writes the story.
Fairness. Rules apply to the strong first, or not at all.
Change. Nothing sacred should outlast its usefulness.
Community. No one stands alone if they don't have to.
bonds: Owes a life-debt they can never fully repay.
Carries a letter they cannot bear to deliver.
Sworn to a mentor whose fate remains unknown.
A hometown they left burning behind them.
A sibling who took a very different path.
A found family scattered across a dozen roads.
A relic that must be returned to where it belongs.
A promise made to a stranger who saved their life.
flaws: Cannot walk away from a fight they've been challenged to.
Trusts appearances over evidence far too readily.
Hoards small things obsessively — coins, buttons, teeth.
Freezes when confronted with authority figures.
Cannot keep a secret longer than a single drink.
Sees betrayal in every unexpected kindness.
Refuses to sleep in unfamiliar beds.
Blames themselves for events beyond their control.
